_comment: Per-position P(win) priors for portfolio_kelly.py. cluster + rho_within define correlation-discount applied via Kelly fraction. cluster_frac is the existing-deployment-as-fraction-of-bankroll for that cluster — used as the discount factor. Resolved-market entries are pruned (git history preserves them).

will-the-iranian-regime-fall-by-the-end-.rationale: 2026-06-28 48h-reassessment (escalation persisted: 2 nights of US strikes over Hormuz shipping, but contained — no regime/leadership targeting, marks unmoved). Fresh bias-corrected catalyst_check: P(YES) central 3% (range 1-7%); structured breakdown 0.55x0.30x0.04x0.50 ~0.5% + ~2.5pp ambient tail. KEY anchor: the Feb-Apr 2026 FULL 40-day US-Israel regime-change campaign FAILED to topple the regime -> a shipping skirmish will not either. p_no 0.88->0.92 (P(YES) ~8%, between the structured-high 7% and the market 9.5%, keeping weight on the Aug-17 negotiation-cliff tail). NO at 0.905 is undervalued vs this. HELD (DEC-0041). ANTI-correlated with iran-peace.

will-reza-pahlavi-lead-iran-in-2026.rationale: Conjunction P(regime falls AND Pahlavi installed) very low. ANTI-correlated with iran-peace.

trump-out-as-president-before-2027.rationale: 2026-06-10 skeptic+champion synthesis: P(YES) ~3% central = death tail 1.5-2.2% (80yo Jun 14, SSA halved for presidential medicine) + assassination 0.3-0.7% (IRGC plots, live war) + resignation ~0.8% + removal ~0. Calendar-structural: Dem House flip seats 2027-01-03 AFTER resolution. cluster_frac raised 0.05->0.18: assassination sliver correlates with iran-regime tail (was set pre-direct-hostilities).

will-the-us-acquire-any-part-of-greenlan.rationale: Entry gate 2026-06-05 used p_no 0.915 (pessimistic); fresh catalyst 2026-06-10 central 0.975 (range 0.94-0.99): 'acquire' = completed territorial transfer, 4-step conjunction in 7mo. Prior 0.95 between them. Idiosyncratic tail (philosophy line 26).

hantavirus-pandemic-in-2026.rationale: Hantavirus outbreak constrained; pandemic in 2026 very low base rate. Correlated-catastrophe tail class — no adds (philosophy line 26).

will-satoshis-identity-be-revealed-by-de.rationale: Subjective-resolution caveat ('revealed' could UMA-resolve loose on a splashy unproven claim — R-U risk category). Entered small (\$5.64) for that reason; NO ADDS despite Kelly deficit. p_no 0.99 = base rate of a 16-year mystery resolving in 6mo.
